nodes.name: Get Daily Summary
nodes.notes: URL uses host.docker.internal since n8n runs in Docker and localhost inside the container isn't the host machine. Update for any non-local deployment.

nodes.name: Send Digest
nodes.notes: Uses Resend's API instead of SMTP — n8n's generic SMTP node has a documented, unresolved bug sending via Gmail on port 465. from address uses Resend's sandbox sender (onboarding@resend.dev), which can only deliver to the email the Resend account was signed up with until a custom domain is verified.

nodes.name: Log Failure
nodes.notes: No error-workflow/alerting channel configured yet (spec: unattended workflows should have one). n8n's own execution history is the failure record for now — check n8n_executions for this workflow if the digest doesn't arrive.
